easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Vesuva, and choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Lumra.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva's ETB ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
As Vesuva enters the battlefield, choose to have it become a copy of Lumra.
Repeat from step 2.
